text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm dropping by the dance studio to pick
up
something I left behind, when
Tamamo Cross
comes up to me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I don't suppose ya got some free
time? If
you do, mind comin' over and
watchin' us
practice?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Us four are helpin' put together this

mummy-themed haunted house as part
of a local
event.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The idea is that the guests and a mummy
hunter
are gonna use toy guns to take
out the mummies
that come at 'em.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's totally unscripted,
so we're practicin'
our
ad-libbin'! Y'know, like improv.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Okay, the mummies are up now, so
would you
mind sharing your impressions
after? The theme is
"mopey mummies."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch! 'Kay, watch closely!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ughhhrrrrawwwrrrrr... The trEAsUre... iS
miiiNe...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gruhhh... Grrrahhh... tHe feSTivAL hAs
cOMe!
YoU wiLL jOiN thE feStiVaL
toOoO!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I lament... that I couldn't care...
for more
people...
Somebody, please... Let me
coddle youuu...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And I am mopey because... I'm hungry. I
haven't
eaten... so I'm going to come and
eat you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... I wonder if you're peckish
because you've not eaten enough
veggies? Let me whip
you up a little
something.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Creek! Throw in some rice and
miso soup
as well. Oh, and don't forget
to make enough for
seconds!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I'll make you as many servings as
you like. ♪ Eat up until you're all full!
Oh, I'm so
delighted to be looking after
you, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I get as much of your cooking as I want... It's like I'm in heaven. ...Drool.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All your reasons for bein' mopey are
goin' out the window! How come yer all
bein' such friendly
mummies?! Get afta
the people already!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'm famished. I've still got
plenty of
room!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's not the point!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Cut! Cut! Tama, how's this supposed to
work when
you're breakin' character and
crackin' jokes?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry about that. Forgot what I was
doin'
there...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Okay, you. How'd we do? And don't go
easy on
us!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This is a disaster! Haunted houses aren't
supposed
to be funny!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I know I shoulda stayed in character, but
Oguri
and Creek were bein' way too
ridiculous!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, I apologize... That wasn't my
intention at
all...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well, it comes naturally to some
folks.
Anyways, look, we gotta get
serious, stat.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We'll have a hunter for the real thing,
right?
Things'll work out so long as the
hunter plays it
straight.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I guess so. Who's playin' the mummy
hunter?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That'd be me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why didn't ya say so?! And how come
yer over
here pretendin' to be a
mummy?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I thought a mummy hunter should try
and
understand how the mummies feel...
Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Are ya still gonna be able to hunt 'em if
yer
empathizin' with 'em? Geez. This
sure isn't lookin'
good.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You should go study your own role now.
Do some
research. Watch a movie about
a hunter or
somethin'.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Okay, got it. You're always so on top of

everything, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No kiddin'... This is supposed to be
horror, but it's
turned into comedy
improv.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, why don't we use scary stage
effects to make it more immersive? They
do say that sounds
and sensations can
heighten suspense.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Why don't we make the event into a
full-on fright-fest? Let's have a look
around the academy
at night for scary
inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's not a bad idea... but no way!
We can't
just hang around at school until
it's dark! Y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Th-the academy sure is scary at night,
huh? Let's hurry up and find somethin'
we can use for the event. Like, how
about the way our footsteps
echo?
choice_data_list: There won't be any problem if I co...
There won't be any problem if I ac...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, speaking of footsteps, have you
heard the rumors? They say a red light
comes chasing after you if you go
running through the academy at
night.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Why're you talkin' about that now?! That's got nothin' to do with the show!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my. Do you... hear that?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
N-nope. Nope. Nopenopenope! I don't
hear
nothin'!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a red light. I wonder if it's the one
Creek was
talking about?
...red... tiful... arv... ous...☆

text_block_list.name: Tamamo and Inari
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Th-this is too much! It's gonna upset da
kids! We
gotta tone it down!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The important thing is that people of all
ages can
have fun! Let's just go with the
comedy version!
